phoneDescription: Enter your mobile number. It will be used to secure your LoveRose account and to validate your top-up transactions.
profileDescription: Help us find singles near you.
ageError: You must be at least 18 years old.
hobbiesDescription: What gets you excited day to day? Pick your favorite interests.
intentsDescription: Select one or more types of connection you're looking for (multiple selection required).
bioDescription: Tell us a bit about yourself. Profiles with honest, engaging bios get up to 80% more contacts.
bioPlaceholder: e.g. Passionate about art and cultural meetups, I love chatting over a good drink and discovering hidden gems...
avatarDescription: Add a real photo of yourself. A visible, smiling face is required to verify your account.
galleryDescription: Add up to three real photos to complete your LoveRose gallery (optional). Complete profiles get 5x more interest!

validation.phoneInvalid: This phone number is not valid for the selected country.
validation.ageMinimum: You must be at least 18 years old to sign up.
validation.locationRequired: Please enter your country or location.
validation.intentsRequired: Please check at least one type of connection you're looking for.
validation.bioTooShort: Your bio must be at least 10 characters long to catch attention.
validation.avatarRequired: Please choose or upload a profile photo.
validation.photoTooLarge: The photo is too large. Please choose an image smaller than 5 MB.

errors.timeout: Your connection is too slow or unstable to finish saving. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.avatarUploadFailed: Your profile photo could not be uploaded (slow or unstable connection). Please try again, ideally on a better connection or Wi-Fi.
errors.genericSubmit: An error occurred while finalizing your profile: {{message}}
errors.gallerySkippedOne: Your profile has been created! One gallery photo could not be uploaded due to your connection — you can add it later from Settings.
errors.gallerySkippedMany: Your profile has been created! {{count}} gallery photos could not be uploaded due to your connection — you can add them later from Settings.
